headline: Discussed Old Tower Hill Road form-based code, an energy-switching app, and a possible garden show; approved the 5/6/2026 minutes.
summary: Members heard a presentation on Kilowant.com, a web app that switches electric customers between energy providers based on up-to-the-minute costs. They also heard updates on the Main Street training program, EDC surveys, and a possible garden show. The only vote recorded was to approve the 5/6/2026 minutes as amended.
decisions: Approved the 5/6/2026 minutes as amended, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the 5/6/2026 minutes as amended was made by Kirk Brown. The motion was seconded by Jack Cadman. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved unanimously.

plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Economic Development Commission   
Amended Meeting Minutes 
Wednesday, July 1, 2026 at 6:00 PM   
Neighborhood Guild, Lounge 
325 Columbia Street, Wakefield, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Michael Gagas, Chair 
Randy Apuzzo, Vice Chair 
Thomas Routliffe 
Ken Tetzner 
Susan Marcus 
Ian Clark 
Jack Cadman 
Kirk Brown 
Gerry Schaffert 
-- vacancy -- 
-- vacancy --  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. 5/6/2026 Draft Minutes 
Ms. Marcus commented that the reference to the "URI garden club" should be changed to reference the Master 
Gardener program. 
A motion to approve the 5/6/2026 minutes as amended was made by Kirk Brown. The motion was seconded by Jack 
Cadman. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved unanimously. 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
M.r Gagas reviewed his two pieces of correspondence. A discussion ensured regarding the existing survey data. Mr. 
Brown discussed some of the details from the data collected by the surveys to date. 
 1. 6-22-2026: Draft request to survey town employees. 
 2. 6-23-2026:  M. Gagas email to Council & Manager re: workforce housing survey results. 
D. Old Business: 
E. New Business: 
 1. S.K. Community Energy Program - Discussion with Rocco Grasso developer/founder of Kilowant.com on AI 
tool for selecting electric energy market providers. 
Rocco and James Grasso made a presentation to the EDC about regarding the web application developed by James 
Grasso, Kilowant.com. The application allows electric consumers to automatically switch between various energy 
providers based on up to the minute energy costs. A discussion followed with board members. 
 2. RI Main Street - Update from EDC representative. Wrap-up of cohort training process and next steps for 
cohort. 
Mr. Brown provided an update on the GrowSmart R.I. Main Street training program. The last full training meeting was 
on 5/30/2026 on "transformation strategies" on how to make the Main Street areas what you want them to be for your 
specific town. A big question moving forward is who will carry the mantle as a Main Street organization in South 
Kingstown. The last meeting of the cohorts will be on 7/24/2026 in Woonsocket with presentations by each of the 
cohorts on proposed strategies or workplans. A discussion followed about defining Main Street areas.  
Mr. Brown also discussed meeting with a member of the Bicycle Pedestrian Committee at the 5/30/2026 meeting and 
the concept of doing a walking audit of the Wakefield Main Street area and accessing existing data in the unfinalized 
Bicycle Pedestrian Master Plan. 
 3. Review of 4/7/2026 Washington County EDC Summit
EDC members who attended the summit meeting discussed some of the topics from the summit. 
 4. AI Agent Power Consumption Application - Discussion 
See agenda item E.1. 
 5. Tour of Westerly State Training Facility 
Mr. Gagas noted that he wanted to organize a trip with the EDC and/or other town boards to see the training facility. 
 6. Development Opportunities at Palisades Mill 
Mr. Apuzzo indicated that he had not spoken to the owner and had nothing to report. 
F. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 1. EDC Surveys - Discussion regarding data collection and next steps with workforce & innovation center 
surveys. 
 2. South Kingstown Garden Show - Continuation of conceptual discussion 
Mr. Schaffert discussed meeting with Mr. Viele at the chamber of commerce about the exploratory effort to create a 
garden show and the inquiry to URI about possible participation. Mr. Viele thought that the idea had potential. A 
discussion followed. 
G. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
 1. Old Tower Hill Road Form-Based Code - Status update & historic attachments overview. 
Staff provided some historic documents about previous EDC efforts in the commercial highway zone. Staff also noted 
that it appeared that the ordinance would be going to Council for public hearing in September, likely the first meeting on 
9/14/2026. Ms. Marcus asked about contact information for people who attended the Old Tower Hill Road charrette to 
let them know about the public hearing. A discussion followed about the hearing process. 
H. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
Staff noted that a new application was anticipated at Fairgrounds Road.  
Ms. Marcus asked about the condominium project at 571 Main Street; staff noted that the town still had not received 
the next application. 
I. Adjournment: 
A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Randy Apuzzo. The motion was seconded by Jack Cadman and the 
meeting adjourned by unanimous consent at 07:47 PM.
